sprint.name: Sprint 2 — Backtesting & Risk Enhancements
sprint.goal: Introduce a reproducible backtesting workflow, extend the Policy Engine (position limits, daily loss cap), and add basic PnL/positions tracking with CLI reporting.

issues.title: SQLite schema & migration script
issues.description: Create SQLite tables for ohlcv, positions, orders, executions, pnl_snapshots, audit_log. Provide migration script.
issues.definition_of_done: Running migration creates all tables; PR includes schema SQL and docs snippet.

issues.title: Data loader for OHLCV (CSV → SQLite)
issues.description: CLI to ingest historical CSV bars into SQLite (symbol, ts, open, high, low, close, volume).
issues.definition_of_done: `python -m src.data.storage load --csv data/AAPL.csv --symbol AAPL` populates rows; counts printed.

issues.title: Backtest loop & signal evaluation
issues.description: Implement vectorized/iterative loop: read bars from SQLite, run SMA strategy, produce signal stream.
issues.definition_of_done: Backtest returns signal count and sample preview for given date range.

issues.title: Order simulation & fills
issues.description: Simulate market orders at next bar open; record executions and update positions.
issues.definition_of_done: Executions persisted; positions updated; unit tests cover buy→sell round trip.

issues.title: Backtest metrics (PnL, max DD, win rate)
issues.description: Compute basic metrics and equity curve; return JSON report + CSV equity curve.
issues.definition_of_done: Backtest outputs JSON with pnl/max_drawdown/win_rate and writes equity_curve.csv.

issues.title: Position limit per symbol
issues.description: Block orders that would exceed per-symbol notional cap.
issues.definition_of_done: Unit test: order exceeding cap returns status=blocked with violation=per_symbol_limit.

issues.title: Daily loss (drawdown) cap
issues.description: Block new orders when daily PnL < -daily_max_drawdown.
issues.definition_of_done: Unit test simulating negative day PnL yields blocked decision with violation=daily_drawdown.

issues.title: Positions model & updater
issues.description: Single source of truth for current position qty and average cost per symbol.
issues.definition_of_done: After simulated fills, positions reflect correct qty/avg_cost in SQLite.

issues.title: Daily PnL snapshot
issues.description: Write end-of-day (or end-of-run) PnL rows to pnl_snapshots table.
issues.definition_of_done: Snapshot rows created with realized/unrealized PnL; unit test verifies totals.

issues.title: Backtest CLI command
issues.definition_of_done: Command runs end-to-end; prints metrics JSON path and equity curve path.

issues.title: Report artifact & README snippet
issues.description: Save metrics JSON and equity curve CSV under artifacts/backtests/<timestamp>/; document usage in README.
issues.definition_of_done: Artifacts folder contains JSON + CSV files; README shows example run and outputs.

issues.title: Benchmark vs SPY (sanity run)
issues.description: Run backtest on AAPL and SPY for 12 months; compare strategy returns to SPY buy/hold baseline.
issues.definition_of_done: Benchmark table included in artifacts; README updated with results summary.

issues.title: Sprint 2 Review & Documentation
issues.description: Summarize changes, update architecture.md (backtest path), and add RUNBOOK backtesting section.
issues.definition_of_done: Docs updated; reviewers can reproduce the backtest and locate artifacts.
